***
Given a valuation `x` of the variable in an `R`-algebra `A`, `aeval R A x` is
the unique `R`-algebra homomorphism from `R[X]` to `A` sending `X` to `x`.

This is a stronger variant of the linear map `Polynomial.leval`.
